verdict.rationale: Brex documents several automation building blocks that can run in the background — auto-enforced budget controls, a Webhooks API for event-driven triggers, and AI-powered automation of invoice entry/approval/payments and GL coding — plus an MCP server for agent integration. However, there's no first-party documentation of a dedicated 'autonomous agent/workflow' orchestration layer or scheduling system, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that these automations run unattended end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented autonomous scheduling/orchestration features, independent verification of unattended operation, and detail on failure handling for background automations.
